free_tier.stated: 1024 GB free ('Network disk capacity limited to 1024GB' on the free column; '1TB Free Cloud Storage for Basic & 2TB Storage for Pro'); Premium/Pro 2048 GB

retention.stated: ~4 GB/file free; ~7-day share-link life; one concurrent download; first-party web login carries a jsToken automated-traffic filter layer

egress.terms: Direct share links, no per-GB fee; free accounts throttled (~2-5 GB/day measured by third parties) and one download at a time

tooling: Unofficial web API (app_id=250528, jsToken) + rclone fork bclone / gulp79/rclone-extra (upstream PR #8508 still open); official Open Platform OAuth is partner-gated
chaining: 1 TB per account, and a second account carries a second allowance; email/SSO signup keeps identity cost low, but the 4 GB/file free cap forces splitting
limits_note: ~4 GB/file free; ~7-day share-link life; one concurrent download; first-party web login carries a jsToken automated-traffic filter layer
reliability_note: no official rclone backend; free-tier daily download cap makes it archive-shaped, and the web API breaks when the client changes
